label: fig:two-questions
data_source: none -- schematic. No plotted value comes from data; no axis carries a value. Nothing here is checkable against RESULTS_cluster because nothing here is a measurement.
action: rework of the inline tikzpicture previously at thesis_v2/Sections/02-Background.tex:148-205

drawn_geometry_cm.comment: TikZ user units, x=1cm y=1cm. Identical to the v1 figure -- nothing in this block changed.
drawn_geometry_cm.points_note: Defined once in \cloudpts and instantiated in both scopes. This is what makes the caption's claim 'Point positions are identical in both panels' structurally true rather than merely checked.

the_one_change.what: Right panel only: the $T$ node label displaced 2pt perpendicular to the P--Ta segment, away from it.
the_one_change.normal_sign_justification: The old offset (0.10,0.03) has normal component +0.10416 cm, so the label already sat on the +n side; +n is therefore 'away from the segment'.

verified_in_built_pdf.units: PostScript pt (72/in), as stored in the PDF

point_cloud_correspondence.method: centres of the five filled/hollow markers in each panel, read from the PDF drawing operators, paired by y
point_cloud_correspondence.conclusion: All five points correspond exactly under the 6.4cm panel shift. The caption's 'Point positions are identical in both panels' holds in the rendered PDF.

collision_measurement.purpose: Show that the change does what it was asked to do.
collision_measurement.method: Two renders at 1600 dpi of the same clip, one with the right-panel $T$ node and one with it suppressed, registered on the $P$ label. Glyph ink = pixels darkened only by the glyph; other ink = pixels already inked without it. Minimum pixel distance between the two masks.
collision_measurement.colliding_mark: the quietink densely-dashed P--Td rival segment (line width 0.45pt), NOT the accent P--Ta segment

at_any_ink_incl_antialias.note: This threshold counts single-bit antialiasing fringe and is too permissive to mean anything at 1600 dpi; recorded only so the sweep is complete.

collision_measurement.conclusion: Before, the dashed rule overlapped the glyph outright. After, roughly 1.6pt of clear white separates them.

size.note: The brief stated 'Drawn width is 402.9pt against a 404.0pt measure'. The measure is right (404.02913pt = 142.0mm) but the drawn width is 346.74pt = 121.9mm, not 402.9pt: the figure under-fills the block by about 20mm. Nothing was rescaled -- the brief also said not to -- and this is reported, not acted on.
